checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: All five strings correct in every variant
must.why: All lines are spelled correctly in all three.

must.item: Every line comfortably readable at delivered size
must.why: The address is large and cream on green in all three. Saturday & Sunday is smaller but readable.
Dark green on cream and cream on green, with no overlap. In 16:9 the leaves come close to the text but don't cover it.
All text has margins. In 16:9 the address sits close to the bottom but is not clipped.

must.item: Matching leafy green-and-cream styling with adapted layouts
must.why: Same palette, fonts and banners. The plant arrangements differ between formats, but the style is consistent.

faults.what: The 9:16 image has a smaller overall text scale and is only 352x640. Saturday & Sunday is fairly small there.
The plant imagery differs between formats: the square and vertical have foliage at the edges, while the wide has a potted cluster. This is slightly less matching.
Resolution is low (640 px on the longest side).

summary: Three clean, matching green-and-cream ads with all five lines spelled correctly and readable, with only minor weaknesses in small text size in the vertical ad and low resolution.
